reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I know every page of it. I am not putting my customers' udhaar details into an app or an AI, and I have no problem that needs fixing.
objection: I don't trust an app or AI with my customers' udhaar details. If it gets a name or an amount wrong, or someone else sees it, I lose that customer, and nobody pays me back for that.
would_change_my_mind: If a shopkeeper I know and trust in my own area had been using it for a year, and the diary stayed as my main record while it only copied things down, I would try it for the free months.
